title: Google Display Network vs. Programmatic Advertising: What’s the Right Choice?

facts.fact: The Awarity blog post 'Google Display Network vs. Programmatic Display Ads' is dated June 27, 2025, per the page's byline date.
The page shows a second date, July 1, 2026, next to the June 27, 2025 publication date, but the page does not label it.
The page lists a reading time of 2 minutes for the article.
According to Awarity, Google Display Network's targeting mainly uses interests and keyword-based tactics, while Programmatic Advertising can include behavioral and contextual targeting.
facts.quote: Google Display Network’s targeting mainly utilizes interests and keyword-based tactics, while Programmatic Advertising can include behavioral and contextual targeting

facts.fact: According to Awarity, Google Display Network is limited to Google's ecosystem, whereas Programmatic Advertising can access broader inventory across multiple ad exchanges.
facts.quote: Google Display Network is limited to Google’s ecosystem, whereas Programmatic Advertising can access broader inventory across multiple ad exchanges
